name: MediaCard
description: Media card for event, article and listing grids: CoverImage cover, title, description, metadata, status chips and a footer, with an optional whole-card link.
designIntent: Every media surface rebuilds the same card: cover art, a title, a date or location line, status chips and a details affordance. MediaCard composes CoverImage, Badge and the ArticleCard stretched-link pattern so imageless entities still look intentional and the card is one target, one hover state, one focus ring.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination URL; the whole card becomes a single link when set.

props.name: cover
props.description: Cover art rendered through CoverImage; seeded gradient fallback included. Pass src, alt, aspect, seed, mark, priority and sizes.

props.name: meta
props.description: Metadata line under the description, e.g. date, location or registration deadline.

props.name: chips
props.description: Status or category chips rendered as Badges; each chip takes label, variant and dot.

props.name: footer
props.description: Bottom slot for a details affordance or secondary text. Keep it non-interactive when the card is a link.

props.name: layout
props.description: 'vertical' stacks the cover over the content; 'row' puts a fixed-width cover beside it for list rows.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description: Custom link element for routers such as Next Link or react-router Link.

props.name: linkHrefProp
props.description: Prop name used to pass the destination to linkComponent.

examples.title: Event card in a grid
examples.code:
<MediaCard
  href={event.href}
  title={event.title}
  description={event.summary}
  cover={{ src: event.imageUrl, alt: event.title, seed: event.slug, sizes: '(min-width: 1024px) 33vw, 100vw' }}
  meta={event.date + ' · ' + event.venue}
  chips={[{ label: 'Registration open', variant: 'outline-success', dot: true }]}
  footer='Details →'
/>
examples.description: Whole-card link with a seeded cover fallback, a deadline meta line and a status chip.

examples.title: List row
examples.code:
<MediaCard
  layout="row"
  href={article.href}
  title={article.title}
  cover={{ alt: article.title, seed: article.slug, aspect: 'square' }}
  meta={article.date}
/>
examples.description: Fixed-width cover beside the content for compact result rows.

antiPatterns.title: Don't nest links or buttons in the footer
antiPatterns.explanation: With href set the whole card is one link, so nested interactive elements are invalid HTML. Keep footer to text, or drop href and compose your own actions.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use it for directory profiles
antiPatterns.explanation: Entity profiles with avatars, stats and tags belong in EntityCard; MediaCard is for media-first surfaces (events, articles, listings).

accessibility.implementation: With href the entire card is one anchor with a visible focus ring; without href it is a static article
accessibility.userRequirements: Do not nest interactive elements inside when href is set

accessibility.implementation: CoverImage renders a real img with alt when src is present; the gradient fallback is aria-hidden
accessibility.userRequirements: Pass a descriptive alt through cover.alt

guidelines: Title is the card's heading; keep meta to one short line (date, venue, deadline)
Footer is a details affordance such as 'Details →', not a second CTA
goodExamples: Mar 14 · Salt Lake City Convention Center
badExamples: Click here to view more information about this event

compositionRules.relationship: The cover prop is forwarded to CoverImage, inheriting its seeded gradient fallback and aspect box
compositionRules.example: <MediaCard cover={{ src, alt, seed: slug, aspect: 'video' }} title={title} />

compositionRules.relationship: chips render as sm Badges; quiet outline tones (outline-success, outline-warning) fit status metadata
Pair with ListToolbar above the grid and Pagination below it for a complete filtered-list surface
